title: TypeArgs

ref.description: A ref a snapshot gave an element (e12, prefixed for a child frame's elements).

anyOf.description: The element with this ref, from the latest snapshot.
The first element this CSS selector matches.

target.description: An element: by ref, or by CSS selector.

text.description: What the field holds afterwards: typing replaces its contents.

snapshot.description: Answer with a snapshot of the page after the action, read as these arguments say; none when absent.

filter.description: interactive (preset): the elements that can be acted on and their context; all: every element.

depth.description: How many levels of the tree to read.

ref.description: Read only the subtree of the element with this ref.

maxChars.description: The most characters to answer, cut at a line boundary; preset 30000, at most 200000.

description: type: replace an input's, a textarea's or an editable element's contents.
